objective: Rerun the instrumented end-to-end Rhino CAD MCP workflow baseline after resolving MCP registration, server startup, and Claude skill discovery, so the next real workflow bottlenecks can be measured without modifying the system during the run.
instructions: This is an observational rerun of the Phase 12 proof of concept. Do not fix, refactor, or improve the bridge, MCP runtime, orientation system, or tooling during the run. Record every issue instead.

Prerequisite: Rhino 8 must already be running before the Rhino connectivity stage. If Rhino is not running, STOP at preflight and record that exact prerequisite failure rather than launching or reconfiguring Rhino.
Use the rhino-chatgpt-orientation skill in operator mode first and apply the fresh payload silently.

From /Users/nes/bin/mcp/rhino-cad-mcp on a clean, up-to-date main, use the normal manual Claude operator lifecycle: fetch/pull --ff-only, discover this request, then ./exchange.sh prepare bridge-phase15-001.

Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase15-001/session-log.json before Rhino mutation and maintain a chronological log with UTC timestamp, stage, outcome, elapsed_seconds when measurable, human_intervention_required, retries, MCP/tool used, and concise notes.

Record baseline operator facts: orientation skill invocation result, local branch/base commit, git cleanliness, Claude version, effective MCP registration result, and visible rhino-cad tool inventory in the current Claude session.
Confirm rhino-cad tools are actually visible through Claude before proceeding. Record tool names and any differences from server.py/README expectations.

Run non-mutating preflight: rhino_status, rhino_list_documents or equivalent document enumeration, and rhino_inspect_document only when targeting is unambiguous. Record structured outcomes, timing, Rhino process/document identifiers, target selection behavior, and retries.

Protect existing user work. Use rhino_create_document or the safest equivalent to create a dedicated isolated document named RHINO_CHATGPT_BRIDGE_POC_002. If document creation/targeting cannot be proven isolated from existing user documents, STOP before mutation and record a high-severity blocker.
Confirm the new document identity explicitly after creation and activate/target it if the MCP requires that. Re-inspect document list/state before geometry creation.

Create a deterministic three-solid assembly in the isolated document using existing MCP capabilities only: rectangular base, vertical cylindrical pedestal, smaller top cap/block. Use sensible dimensions in document units. Prefer one high-level rhino_run transaction or the safest deterministic operation supported by the current MCP; do not add new tools.

Create or use a dedicated POC layer if supported. Set names or user-string metadata on each object such as role, created_by=bridge-phase15-001, revision=1, and operation_id. Read the metadata back and record results.
Validate each object using rhino_validate or equivalent. Record GUID, type, validity, solid/manifold status when available, bounding box, dimensions, area/volume when returned, and metadata readback.
Run rhino_validate_assembly if available. Record duplicate/interference/invalid-solid findings and any inconclusive checks. Do not interpret unavailable checks as success.

Capture visual evidence using rhino_capture_views, rhino_capture_viewport, or rhino_visual_qa as available. Prefer one deterministic isometric view and at least one orthographic/secondary view. Preserve resulting PNG(s), contact sheet if present, manifest JSON, and scene archive if generated under .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase15-001/.

Save the isolated POC document with rhino_save_as or verified equivalent to a deterministic non-existing path under a safe temp/artifact location. Record file path, file size, readback object count, verification result, and active-document path behavior.
After save, re-inspect the POC document and record final object count, layer count, target/document identity, and whether it remains the active document.
Do not close or delete the POC document automatically if evidence preservation would be compromised. Report its final state clearly so the user can close it manually if desired.

Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase15-001/workflow-assessment.json with architecture_path_observed, stage_metrics, mcp_tool_inventory, rhino_preflight, document_isolation, cad_operations, validation_results, artifact_manifest, save_results, retries_and_errors, manual_interventions, ambiguities, friction_points, and recommendations.

For friction_points, classify severity high/medium/low and category from onboarding, git_bridge, request_protocol, branch_lifecycle, mcp_discovery, rhino_targeting, mutation_safety, tool_schema, latency_timeout, artifact_handoff, validation, reporting, or other. Include concrete evidence and exact stage.
Separate recommendations into QUICK_WINS, PROTOCOL_CHANGES, and MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES. Do not implement recommendations.

Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase15-001/operator-experience.md summarizing what felt smooth, what was awkward, what required reasoning/manual intervention, and the top five workflow improvements ranked by impact.

Measure the full workflow from orientation through pushed receipt. Include total elapsed time and counts of Git commands, MCP calls, retries, manual interventions, and handoff steps. Label estimates explicitly.

Do not modify server.py, bridge.py, runtime_ops.py, tool_support.py, snippets.py, requirements.txt, knowledge/, tests/, .mcp.json, installer/skill/orientation files, operator.sh, exchange.sh, orient.sh, or .bridge/bridge_cli.py during this baseline rerun.

Do not install dependencies, re-register MCP servers, change Claude config, restart/reconfigure services, or force through a failure. If any such action becomes necessary, STOP and record the blocker.
Run git diff --check and verify the task branch contains only POC evidence/artifacts/report files, not implementation changes.
Commit POC evidence/artifacts as the work commit and capture RESULT_COMMIT.
Create .bridge/reports/bridge-phase15-001.json with ack exactly BRIDGE-PHASE15-RHINO-POC-RERUN-20260924-91C4F2-OPERATOR-ACK, exact base_commit, RESULT_COMMIT, and branch operator/bridge-phase15-001.

The report summary must classify the full path ChatGPT controller -> Git request -> Claude operator -> rhino-cad MCP -> rhinocode/Rhino -> validation/artifacts -> Git report as COMPLETE, PARTIAL, or BLOCKED and name the first failing stage if not complete.
Run python3 .bridge/bridge_cli.py verify-report bridge-phase15-001 and require REPORT_OK.
Commit the report as the separate receipt commit, push operator/bridge-phase15-001, and do not merge it.
expected_outputs: .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase15-001/ with visual evidence and manifests if the Rhino path reaches capture
constraints: Observation only; do not fix issues during the rerun.
Never mutate an existing user Rhino document.
Require isolated document identity before CAD mutation.
Do not claim successful validation for checks that did not run.
No dependency installation, MCP/Claude reconfiguration, force push, or merge.
Stop and record any new safety or environment prerequisite failure rather than bypassing it.
